title: Environmental impacts of three high-performance thermoplastics (HPTPs) and associated glass-fiber reinforced grades from different processing technologies
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,972-986
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00615E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aicha Touré, Jannick Duchet Rumeau, Bérenger Thollet, Emile Pantaleao, Jérémy Sautel, Sylvestre Njakou Djomo
Environmental impacts of high-performance thermoplastics (HPTPs) are driven by feedstock production and processing technologies. Environmental impacts of glass filled HPTPs are lower than those of unfilled HPTPs.
